claims.assertion: Athena described Hanáre/Scimitar fighters as A interceptors optimized for speed and B assault craft carrying troops and up to two armored vehicles.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: A variants are 50–55 meters long; B variants are 60 meters.

claims.assertion: She said Scimitars use toroidal high-energy stealth to evade human visible-light, infrared, and microwave detection; gravitational-shift sensors could detect them.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She said the Cabal lacked the latter technology.

claims.assertion: Athena said Scimitars are fully interstellar; one person can pilot either variant, and their onboard AI can fly them autonomously.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

review_flags: All spacecraft specifications and operational claims are attributed to Athena.
coverage_gaps: Armor, shields, weapons, propulsion details, and hyperspace travel time
